name: Aaroh Kandhare
summary: Aaroh Kandhare builds solutions for people, physical and technological.
description: Builder focused on robotics, CAD, combat robotics, rockets, manufacturing, education technology, AI translation, back-end web development, product development, operations, and physical products.

timeline.title: VEX Team Lead
timeline.description: Co-lead for 5 years and main lead for 2 more, driving team to state competitions and global invitationals.

timeline.description: Oversaw teams building VEX robots and provided feedback to students.

timeline.title: Interlake Rocketry Club Team Lead
timeline.description: Led a team of 10 designing rockets in CAD and created a simulation for actively controlled rockets.

timeline.title: 1899 Saints Robotics
timeline.description: Led a sub-team building a t-shirt cannon robot and managed complex design requirements and budget.

timeline.title: Teaching Team Lead
timeline.description: Taught elementary students robotics, coding basics, CAD, and leadership skills.

timeline.title: Club President of Interlake Builders Club
timeline.description: Guided team direction, boosted membership by 275%, and mentored members.

timeline.title: Founder and Captain of Mantis Combat Robotics
timeline.description: Founded and led a combat robotics team.

timeline.title: DECA Competitive Events SCDC Qualifier
